entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: The black-red demon-worshipping guild of Ravnica that provides menial labor and entertainment and keeps its demon quiescent.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: An ancient demon, founder of the Cult of Rakdos, who sleeps for months to years and demands entertainment when awake.

entities.name: Izolda
entities.description: The human bloodwitch and acting guildmaster who woke Rakdos at the Decamillennial and was devoured by her followers.

entities.name: Exava
entities.description: A bloodwitch who wields the most power among the Bloodwitches.

entities.name: Hekara
entities.description: A bloodwitch and Rakdos's emissary, killed and revived in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Bloodwitches
entities.description: A cadre of powerful witches in Rix Maadi who are the closest thing to advisors to Rakdos.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: A figure who plotted to overthrow Rakdos while he rested.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker whose group went to convince non-cooperating guilds to help Niv-Mizzet's plan.

entities.name: Tomik
entities.description: A character who brought Hekara's corpse back.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who rode Rakdos against Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon planeswalker who knocked Rakdos out of the air.

entities.name: Feather
entities.description: A Boros angel who threw the comatose Rakdos back into his lava pit.

entities.name: Jarad
entities.description: A man whose blood, and that of his son Myc, was used to rouse Rakdos.

entities.name: Project Kraj
entities.description: A construct that absorbed Rakdos into its body.

entities.name: Rix Maadi
entities.description: Rakdos's lava pit lair where the Bloodwitches reside.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane and city home to the Cult of Rakdos.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A guild increasingly clashing with the Cult of Rakdos.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion of Ravnica that the Cult helped defend against.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The conflict against Bolas on Ravnica.

events.summary: At the Decamillennial, Izolda uses dragon spinal fluid and the blood of Jarad and Myc to rouse Rakdos, who wreaks havoc until absorbed by Project Kraj.
events.quote: Rakdos awakened and wreaked havoc in the streets of Ravnica until the demon crossed the path of Project Kraj .

events.summary: The Boros angel Feather throws the comatose Rakdos back into his lava pit.
events.quote: the comatose Rakdos was thrown back into his lava pit, Rix Maadi, by the Boros angel Feather

events.summary: Sensing weakness after Rakdos's defeat, Izolda's followers devour her alive.
events.quote: Izolda's followers summarily devoured her alive.

events.summary: In the War of the Spark, Rakdos refuses to cooperate because Hekara was killed.
events.quote: Rakdos initially was not cooperating at all with the anti-Bolas efforts because Hekara , his emissary, was killed.

events.summary: Tomik brings back Hekara's corpse and she is revived as a bloodwitch; she beats Exava in a fight and agrees to help Kaya's group.
events.quote: Exava tried to object but lost to Hekara in a fight.

events.summary: Rakdos serves as Gideon's Unlikely Aid against Bolas and is knocked out of the air.
events.quote: He was knocked out of the air by Bolas when Gideon was riding him.

events.summary: The Cult fights in Ravnica's defense during the New Phyrexian Invasion, then fills the aftermath with entertainments, increasingly clashing with the Boros.
events.quote: The Cult fought just as hard as anyone else in Ravnica's defense during the New Phyrexian Invasion .

events.summary: Judith plots to overthrow Rakdos unsuccessfully, and he leaves Ravnica for Thunder Junction via an Omenpath.
